newsitem.title: USA: Uruguay seeks one mln bbls of crude oil for August.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay seeks one mln bbls of crude oil for August.

text.p: Uruguay's state oil refiner ANCAP is seeking to buy one million barrels of crude oil for August 18-28 delivery, trade sources said on Tuesday.
The company is looking to purchase crude with an API gravity of around 26-45 degrees and a sulfur content of 0.5 percent to 1.8 percent.
The crude is to be delivered to Uruguay's Jose Ignacio terminal.
The company will receive bids on July 2, and award the tender late on July 3.
In its last purchase tender, ANCAP bought one million barrels of Venezuelan Mesa-30 crude from Lagoven, a subsidiary of state Petroleos de Venezuela, for July 19-27 delivery.
ANCAP paid between $3.25 and $3.30 a barrel under benchmark West Texas Intermediate/Cushing on a delivered basis for the Venezuelan crude.
